The correct answer is 1999, as the song "Oh My God" was released on the End of Days soundtrack in 1999.

Looking at the conversation, the first agent to respond was the Planner, who correctly identified the film as End of Days and the promo as "Oh My God" from 1999. The key mistake seems to have happened when the WebSurfer considered the Billboard chart data, which showed the song peaking in early 2000. This led to a consideration of 2000 as the promo year, but upon closer examination, the promo activity for the soundtrack itself was in 1999.

So, the mistake was made by the WebSurfer agent in step 5 when they considered the Billboard data, leading to a potential misclassification of the promo year as 2000 instead of 1999. The error was corrected upon realizing that the promo was tied to the 1999 release.
